lines.text: John heard in prison about the works of Christ and sent his disciples to ask if Jesus was the One to come.
Jesus told John's disciples to report that the blind receive sight, the lame walk, and the dead are raised.
Jesus asked the crowds what they went out into the wilderness to see, and said fine clothing is found in temple courts.
Jesus said John is more than a prophet and is the Isaiah who was to come.
Jesus compared this generation to children in the marketplaces, saying people called John demon-possessed and called the Son of Man a glutton and drunkard.
